feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: 'If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again' — the second clause 'if at_exit, then holding_box at some point' uses RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box), but 'you must be carrying the box' at the exit means holding_box must hold on the exit step itself, and RespondedExistence lets holding_box occur at any time, before or after reaching the exit. The compiled machine confirms this: from u4, a step with at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box pays 0.1 and moves to u1, so reaching the exit already with the box counts, and from u0 a step at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box merely pays -0.1 without failing, letting the episode end with an empty-handed exit. Replace the clause with a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box)? No — that would allow holding_box later. Since at_exit is a last-step-only condition and 'carrying the box' at that moment is required, use ChainResponse(at_exit, holding_box) hard (holding_box on the very next step of an at_exit step), or equivalently an order rule forbidding exiting while not holding, and keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) unchanged.
